seoTitle: Mileage Allowance Calculator at Your Rate
metaDescription: Calculate a business mileage reimbursement from kilometres and a per-km rate, with an optional second rate after a distance.
intro: Reimbursement for business kilometres at rates that you enter.
why:
Many employers and tax authorities set per-km rates, sometimes lower after a distance. Enter your rate and the tool does the arithmetic and checks an optional annual cap.

No official rates are bundled because they change by country and year.
howTo: Optionally set a second rate and distance.

faq.a: The current figure from your tax authority or employer policy.
Date, route, purpose and odometer readings.
